5dn.text: Yert is a Moriok whom Glissa wins over after slaughtering his Reaper, but he is fed to Geth's vampire, rises as a vampire himself and beheads Geth, who survives as a lich-head.
Now a vampire, Yert captures Glissa, though Ellasha sacrifices herself so Glissa escapes.
Glissa teleports into Yert, killing him, and takes the Miracore.
